  [2] File: .github/workflows/review_autofix.yml
      Problem: Regression - missing detection of staged new files removed by simplification; Previous code had `git diff --cached --diff-filter=A --name-only HEAD` to capture staged new files that `git ls-files --others` misses. New simplified code removes this check, causing staged new files to be lost from commits (historical bug PR #1330). `git diff --name-only HEAD` may not reliably show staged new files in all edge cases (empty files, .gitignore edge cases, etc.).; HARDENING_SUGGESTIONS:
      Confidence: avg 4.0
      Flagged by: deepseek_deepseek-v3_2

  [3] File: .github/workflows/review_autofix.yml
      Problem: Location: lines ~1691-1692; Regression - missing detection of staged new files.; The previous implementation explicitly included `git diff --cached --diff-filter=A --name-only HEAD` to capture files that the editor created and then staged. `git ls-files --others` skips files already in the index, and `git diff --name-only HEAD` (without `--cached`) primarily reflects the working tree's relationship to `HEAD`. If a file is newly created and then staged, it moves from "untracked" to "staged addition". In this state, it is invisible to `ls-files --others` and may be inconsistently reported by `git diff HEAD`. This specific edge case previously caused false "Editor changes lost" alerts (PR #1330) because the file was missing from the `touched_path` list and subsequently wiped by the `git read-tree HEAD` reset. The simplification removed the robust check for these staged additions.; HARDENING_SUGGESTIONS:
      Confidence: avg 4.0
      Flagged by: google_gemini-3-flash-preview

  [4] File: .github/workflows/review_autofix.yml
      Problem: Location: lines ~1691-1692 (touched-file collection in the "Commit changes" step, under IS_WORKFLOW_SOURCE_REPO=true); Issue: Both git commands are terminated with `|| true`, silencing failures. If either or both commands fail (e.g., git corruption or environment error), CODEX_TOUCHED_FILE may be empty or incomplete, causing editor changes to be lost without a clear error signal.; Suggested minimal fix: Capture exit statuses and abort on failure to fail fast and surface the problem. For example:; git diff --name-only HEAD >> "${CODEX_TOUCHED_FILE}"; _diff_rc=$?; git ls-files --others --exclude-standard >> "${CODEX_TOUCHED_FILE}"; _ls_rc=$?; if [ $_diff_rc -ne 0 ] || [ $_ls_rc -ne 0 ]; then; echo "::error::Touched-file detection failed (diff=$_diff_rc, ls=$_ls_rc); aborting commit"; exit 1; Alternatively, write a flag file on error and check before proceeding.; Estimated lines changed: 6-8; HARDENING_RISK_SCORE: 3 (moderate robustness gain; prevents silent data loss; fails fast for human investigation)
      Confidence: avg n/a
      Flagged by: stepfun_step-3_5-flash

  [5] File: .github/workflows/review_autofix.yml
      Problem: Location: line ~1691, immediately after `git diff --name-only HEAD >> "${CODEX_TOUCHED_FILE}" || true`; Issue: As a defensive redundancy (extreme safety), explicitly capture staged-only additions via `git diff --cached --diff-filter=A --name-only HEAD`, as was present in the previous implementation. While `git diff HEAD` already includes staged additions and this line is therefore redundant, it adds no cost beyond one cheap git call and ensures staged-only files are captured even under unusual git states.; Suggested minimal fix: Insert:; git diff --cached --diff-filter=A --name-only HEAD >> "${CODEX_TOUCHED_FILE}" 2>/dev/null || true; Estimated lines changed: 1; HARDENING_RISK_SCORE: 0 (harmless redundancy; no risk; improves confidence); No other issues were identified. The PR changes correctly implement the intended simplification, and the earlier snapshot-based logic that could drop editor changes when files were pre-dirty has been removed.
